class.name: NNBTInverter
class.brief_description: Ticks the first enabled behaviour tree child node it has and returns the inverted result to its parent.
class.description: The inverter node ticks its first enabled behaviour tree child node and returns the inverted result to its parent: [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] becomes [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE], and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] becomes [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS]. If the child returns [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] or [constant NNBTNodes.SKIP], that result is returned unchanged. If no behaviour tree child is enabled, the inverter returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].
